sourceReview.observedAncestry: Credential HTML carries course.dp-800t00; course HTML names learn.wwl.implement-ai-capabilities-database-solutions; path HTML matches that UID and canonical URL. MCP path links models/search modules; their indexes link teaching units and summaries. Summary links supply distance/search/type, vector-patterns explicitly names normalization, and hybrid explicitly uses division. Course is ancestry only, never technical support.
conflictsNotAdopted: Training universally describes earlier TOP_N/post-filter/read-only behavior; latest Azure product qualifies it by format and rollout.
VECTOR_SEARCH complete-workflow example adds a title ORDER BY key despite explicit distance-only restrictions. The selected fresh query obeys the restriction.
Hybrid training has unordered TOP clauses, BM25 terminology and broad performance/recall prose. Only the precise expression, inclusion and evaluation claims are adopted.
Vector-patterns BaseType and model-normalization generalizations do not authorize unrelated model compatibility or float16 claims.
sourceReview.datePolicy: Every final cited source review exactly matches the frozen manifest; newer inspected ancestor review metadata was reread, not changed.

duplicateReview.scope: Targeted reading of the 155-record integration all-candidates.json concept index and relevant complete candidates, selected combined-duplicates.txt warnings, and actual installed canonical snapshots. This is not an all-credential semantic audit or a new blanket scan.

comparisons.reason: Real-valued RRF addition, SQL numeric/NULL repair, candidate inclusion and query-level TOP ordering are different facts. direct-024 independently holds for construction quality.
Labeled relevance recall and first-hit MRR with a latency tie-break are not ANN exact-neighbor overlap.
Norm output arithmetic differs from dimensions metadata and negative-dot metric ordering.
Exact scalar contract, index compatibility and forced-ANN strategy control answer different questions.
Earlier post-filter outcome, hard eligibility before both branch budgets, latest grammar migration and outer aggregation are different failures.

duplicateReview.canonicalPolicy: The seven direct IDs are replacements, not extra questions. Six current installed authored texts match the new substance; direct-049 is a genuinely changed paired-edit Intermediate snapshot and no old approval was inherited.
duplicateReview.warningDisposition: Pronouns have immediate query/statement antecedents. direct-046 short prose is completed by typed literal SQL and rounding. direct-024 absolute priority and unique worked-answer clues are a hold. No claimed global semantic clearance.

staticChecks.method: Static function/grammar reasoning and independent arithmetic over stipulated fixtures; JavaScript numbers here illustrate the proof, not SQL numeric precision.
